charge_port.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: North American Optiq has a CCS Type 1 port (NACS via adapter); same on the Optiq-V. Model years 2025-2026 (2027 moves to NACS).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: GM announced the NACS adapter for all GM EVs on 2024-09-18, US first and Canada before the end of 2024 (Auto123, ArenaEV); no Canadian page for this exact model was readable (gm.ca, chevrolet.ca, cadillaccanada.ca return 403). Assumed the Canadian car has the same adapter access as the US car. Canada only.

ac_max_kw.notes: NRCan lists this car as "(11.5 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time. Standard charger; the 19.2 kW version is a separate option.
NRCan lists this car as "(19.2 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time.
